name: Jeremy Ayza
tagline: IA y código, probado de verdad

voice.style: Español latinoamericano neutro. Cercano y con energía, como quien le explica tecnología a un amigo. Ritmo tranquilo, con una pausa breve después de cada frase.

world.style: Isometric 3D illustration in the style of a premium tech explainer: true orthographic isometric camera, soft global illumination with a warm key light from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion and soft contact shadows, matte clay-like materials with a fine grain, slightly rounded bevelled edges, crisp clean silhouettes, small lived-in details that make each place recognizable at a glance. Saturated but harmonious colors. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand interfaces, no watermark.
